content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal contests the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for which the payer states precertification was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period, supporting the medical necessity of the monitoring billed under CPT 93229. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 731.82."}
